newsitem.title: SPAIN: De Benedetti to sell 48 pct stake in Cofir.
newsitem.headline: De Benedetti to sell 48 pct stake in Cofir.

text.p: Italian financier Carlo de Benedetti is looking for a single buyer for his 48.05 percent stake in Spain's Corporacion Financiera (Cofir), the financial daily Expansion said on Monday.
French company Cerus, through which de Benedetti holds his stake, made the decision to sell several months ago but has still not found a buyer, a spokesman for Cofir told Reuters on Monday.
Cerus values its stake in the Spanish holding group at 24 billion pesetas, 40 percent above its market quotation, according to Expansion. Cofir closed at 339 pesetas on Friday.
The planned sale has paralysed the initial public offer of hotel chain NH Hoteles, a unit of Cofir which was expected to start quoting on the Spanish stock exchange before the end of the year.
